fusions.name: Fording Bound
fusions.desc: Bounds you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then lands in a splash that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaves them [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed and Regrown
fusions.desc: Sheds a tine and casts it for 9 damage. Also costs 4% of your maximum health. 30% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bolt to Cover
fusions.desc: Springs you 3 tiles from where you stood, and restores 4 health a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Winded, Then Still
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
